overall_assessment: Section extraction for NIH works very well: every heading (Kort om emnet, Læringsutbytte, Læringsformer og aktiviteter, Arbeidskrav, Vurdering/eksamen) maps to the right section, arbeidskrav stay out of assessment, plagiarism/WISEflow notices are removed and placeholder-only reading lists are correctly not emitted. All 'leak->' pre-pass flags are false alarms (words like 'arbeidskrav' or 'Emnets innhold' occurring inside the correct section). The only defect is a minor inconsistency in how 'Ingen ...' prerequisites are treated.

findings.description: Inconsistent handling of 'no prerequisites' under the Forkrav heading. LKI130-1 emits a prerequisites row containing only the placeholder 'Ingen emner' (flagged empty), while LKI110-1 and LKI120-1 (2025), whose Forkrav text is 'Ingen emner i programmet', get no prerequisites row. The same non-content ends up as a row in one course and is dropped in the others.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The placeholder list used by .keep_section_row()/.placeholder_phrases in R/extract_sections.R matches 'Ingen' only in some exact forms, so 'Ingen emner i programmet' is dropped but 'Ingen emner' survives (or vice versa).
findings.suggested_fix: Make the placeholder rule in R/extract_sections.R (.placeholder_phrases) match '^Ingen( emner)?( i programmet)?\.?$' so all variants are dropped as empty placeholders.
